text:
Sorry about the mix-up, that's frustrating when you ordered a specific plant. The policy I have says incorrect items are returned free of charge, but it doesn't say whether a wrong live plant has to be sent back or how it's resolved (for example, a replacement pothos or a refund). I don't want to guess, so I can escalate this to a Support Lead to confirm the right outcome for you.

If a return is needed, you'd start it from "My Orders" and get a prepaid label by email. The label expires after 7 days, and refunds are issued within 5 business days of the parcel reaching our warehouse. Would you like me to escalate this?
